THE BIG STORY
Tesla's profit drop

lines.text: Tesla's sales held flat. Its profit fell 43%.
lines.say: Tesla's sales held flat. Its profit fell forty-three percent.

lines.text: Tesla posted its third-quarter results on Wednesday.
lines.say: Tesla posted its third-quarter results on Wednesday.

lines.text: Revenue came in at $28.05 billion, roughly flat from a year earlier.
lines.say: Revenue came in at twenty-eight point oh five billion dollars, roughly flat from a year earlier.

lines.text: But net profit dropped from $1.37 billion to $787 million.
lines.say: But net profit dropped from one point three seven billion dollars to seven hundred eighty-seven million.

lines.text: Part of the reason: research and development spending jumped 69%, to $2.76 billion.
lines.say: Part of the reason is that research and development spending jumped sixty-nine percent, to two point seven six billion dollars.

lines.text: Tesla tied its higher costs to AI projects, stock pay including Elon Musk's 2025 award, and admin costs.
lines.say: Tesla tied its higher costs to A I projects, stock pay including Elon Musk's twenty twenty-five award, and admin costs.

lines.text: So operating income, the profit from running the business, fell to $718 million from $1.62 billion.
lines.say: So operating income, the profit from running the business, fell to seven hundred eighteen million from one point six two billion.

lines.text: The lesson: sales show what a company brings in, and profit shows what it actually keeps after the bills.
lines.say: Here's the lesson: sales show what a company brings in, and profit shows what it actually keeps after the bills.
